intent: Plan usage or AI credits against a limit: total, usage by category, a daily line with the cap, and a warning near the limit. Composes kit Meter, UsageList, LineChart and Alert.
useWhen: show credits or plan usage for the current period
warn before a limit and offer the upgrade
break usage down by category and day
doNotUseWhen: prompt context in a thread — ContextWindow

categories.note: { id, label, value }[] listed with a kit UsageList against the limit.

daily.note: Kit LineChart (line), with the daily cap as a second line.

onUpgrade.note: Upgrade plan, the one solid primary; shown near or over the limit.

requirements: the total is a kit Meter with a full text label
the daily line is a kit LineChart with its data table
near limit and limit reached are said in a Badge and a kit Alert, not colour alone
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local CreditMeter or BillingUsage
Do not reimplement Meter, UsageList or LineChart inside it
Do not show Upgrade as the primary when usage is normal
snippet: <UsageMeter title="AI credits · Pro plan" used={9240} limit={10000} categories={categories} periodStart="Nov 1" resetLabel="resets Dec 1" daily={daily} dailyCap={1000} onUpgrade={upgrade} onViewUsage={viewUsage} />
